faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Assistant-II position at CSIR NEERI is 03 September 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Environmental Science, Life Science, or Chemistry from a recognized university, or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology (Civil/Chemical Engg.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant-II position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Assistant-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant-II post will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position of Project Assistant-II at CSIR NEERI is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of CSIR NEERI or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any relaxation in the age limit?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.
